title: Health Information Technology Assistant
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Health Information Technology Assistant Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to apply the knowledge and skills needed to perform Health Information Technology Associate Degree entry-level competencies as defined by the American Health Information Management Association’s (AHIMA) Council for Excellence in Education (CEE).
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to apply the knowledge and skills needed to successfully pass the national Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT) exam.

Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to apply biomedical knowledge (anatomy and physiology, pharmacology, pathophysiology, medical terminology) to the process of clinical code assignment

Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to demonstrate the ability to work effectively as an individual and collaboratively in a group to resolve health information challenges in a changing healthcare environment.
At the conclusion of this program, the student should be able to demonstrate competency in the measurement, analysis, and interpretation of health data and health law.

At the conclusion of this program, the student should be able to apply the knowledge and technical skills required for successful HIM entry-level employment as a health information professional in various healthcare settings.
At the conclusion of this program, the student should be able to successfully utilize computer applications necessary for entry-level HIM employment as a health information professional.

At the conclusion of this program, the student should be able to exhibit the behavioral, interpersonal, ethical and professional skills for entry-level employment in Health Information Management as a health information professional in various healthcare settings.

notes: The catalog prints codes without a space (e.g. 'BSADB6', 'STATC1000E'); they are written here with the subject separated to match the closed list.

The Program Learning Outcomes heading prints two numbered lists of four outcomes each. The first set refers to Associate Degree entry-level competencies and the RHIT exam and may belong to the HIT A.S. degree rather than this certificate; all eight are recorded as printed on this certificate's page. Reviewer should check.
Outcome 3 of the first list is printed without a terminal period; copied as printed.
List A requires 4-4.5 units from STAT C1000 (4) or STAT C1000E (4.5), effectively one of the two statistics courses.
No careers are named in the visible section; the program description text is cut off at the start.
